Principle 9: What Do I Do Every Day?
Every day I usually follow the same schedule.
I get up at six o’clock every morning.
I clean my room, and then I go jogging with my dog named Happy.
I run to and from the playground five times.
After I finish jogging, I take a shower.
I have breakfast around 7:30 a.m. After breakfast,
I brush my teeth, and I leave for school at about eight o’clock.
I often meet my friends and play around a little in the schoolyard
before we go to class.
I have four morning classes that start at nine.
Each class is about forty-five minutes long.
I have lunch at 12:30 p.m. After lunch, I have two more classes.
I finish my classes at 3:00 p.m.
After school, I go to private academies whereI study Art, Piano and
English. Each academy lesson lasts around fifty minutes.
Sometimes I get very tired when I’m at the academies,
but I enjoy studying with my friends there. A
fter my last academy class, I get home at around 6:00 p.m.
After finishing classes at the academies,
I go home and have dinner with my family.
My mother always makes dinner.
When we eat, my father usually talks about his day,
and we share our experiences.
After dinner, we watch television together.
My favorite TV. shows are Miracle and Fantastic.
I start my homework at around 9:00 p.m.
My English homework is my favorite.
It is my favorite because it is easier than my other subjects.
After that, I quickly write in my journal about my day.
I go to bed at about 10:30 p.m. and think what a wonderful day it was!
